title: end is no end
description: From radioactive survival to divine godhood — gather 8 dimensional shards, craft powerful machinery, and defeat the Deity to claim the Essence of Creation.
body:
🌌 Genesis & Radiance: The Path to Divinity
Welcome to a massive expansion that blends high-tech machinery with ancient divine magic. Your journey will take you from the depths of radioactive caves to a final confrontation with the Deity itself.

⚔️ The Ultimate Goal: Summoning the Deity
To face the final boss, you must prove your mastery over all realms. You will need to craft and collect 8 Dimensional Shards, representing the core elements of existence:

🌌 End Shard | 🔥 Nether Shard

🌊 Water Shard | ☁️ Sky Shard

☢️ Radiation Shard | ...and 3 more rare fragments.
These shards require endgame materials and complex crafting recipes. Only the most dedicated players will be able to summon the God of this world.

☢️ Radiation & Industrialization
Explore the world to find Radiation Ore, but stay alert—the new Radiation Zombies haunt the caves.

Isotope Extractor: Process radioactive flesh and ore into stable Radiation Capsules.

Advanced Machinery: Power your base with new technological blocks:

Electric Furnace & Crusher: Efficiently process materials.

Incubator: For advanced biological experiments.

Purification: Cleanse your Diamonds, Gold, and Iron to reach their maximum potential.

👼 Angelic Tier
Using the Angelic Linker, fuse your purified materials into Angelic Ingots.

Angelic Armor: Grants powerful buffs and unmatched protection.

Angelic Sword: Unleashes holy abilities to smite your enemies.

⚡ The Essence of Creation
Defeating the Deity is not the end. Victory rewards you with Essence of Creation, a material used to craft god-tier equipment:

Deity Set: The most powerful armor and sword in the game, granting flight, lightning strikes, and rapid regeneration.

Unobtainable Items: Gain access to powerful artifacts and items previously restricted to Creative Mode.

🛠️ Tools & Utility
1x2 Drills: Optimized for efficient tunnel mining.

Magic Staves: Master the elements with various magical abilities.

And much more: New ores, blocks, and items to discover!

Key Features:
Progression: A clear path from early-game mining to late-game godhood.

New Mechanics: A mix of tech (processing/extraction) and magic (shards/summoning).

Boss Fight: A challenging battle with unique rewards.

Will you be the one to master the elements and claim the Essence of Creation?
